children: Uppal joins as Head of Marketing, while Grover takes charge of Category Planning & Strategy for Greater India

EssilorLuxottica has appointed Ashwin Uppal as Head of Marketing, Greater India and Ameya Grover as Head of Category Planning & Strategy, Greater India. Both executives will join the company’s Leadership Team headed by Venu Ambati, President, Greater India.

Uppal brings more than 24 years of experience across FMCG, retail, technology, entertainment and alternative assets, with expertise spanning marketing strategy, brand building, sales and innovation. His career includes leadership roles at Reckitt, Godrej Consumer Products, L’Oréal, Jio and Baskin-Robbins.

Over the course of his career, Uppal has worked across more than 200 brands in over 100 countries. He has also been associated with Nestlé and Lowe Lintas, where he worked on campaigns for brands including Nescafé, Maggi, Lifebuoy, Idea and Britannia.

Before joining EssilorLuxottica, Uppal was Global Chief Marketing Officer at RMZ. In that role, he led the group’s global marketing agenda across sectors including real estate, consumer, sports, retail, hospitality, logistics, AI and data centres.

Grover, who has joined as Head of Category Planning & Strategy, Greater India, brings experience across consulting, e-commerce and strategy. She holds an MBA from the Indian School of Business, Hyderabad, and a Bachelor of Business Studies in Finance from the University of Delhi.

Prior to EssilorLuxottica, Grover was Head of Platform Strategy at JioMart, part of Reliance Retail. She led platform strategy for JioMart’s quick-commerce business, developed multi-year growth roadmaps and worked on new business opportunities.
Earlier, Grover worked with McKinsey and Amazon India, bringing experience in strategic planning and execution across businesses.

The appointments come as EssilorLuxottica continues to strengthen its leadership structure in India, with Uppal overseeing marketing and Grover focusing on category planning and strategy for the Greater India market.
